cursor_overlay.label: Draw the cursor pointer arrow
cursor_overlay.description: The "Show cursor pointer arrow" keybind draws an arrow at the cursor through a small GTK overlay helper (needs python-gobject, gtk4-layer-shell and python-cairo). Takes effect when the daemon restarts.

daemon_path.label: Daemon script
daemon_path.description: Path to hyperzone.py. Empty = the one next to this plugin (or one level up, in the repo). Takes effect when the daemon restarts.
